Provident Real Estate is pleased to offer this spacious 3-bedroom villa in Serro, a premium cluster within The Heights by Emaar. Set on a large private plot, this home offers modern layouts, abundant natural light, and a peaceful, green community environment. Ideal for end-users and long-term investors seeking an early entry into a new Emaar master development.
.
